The '''Ruling Council''' was an assembly of officials charged with governing the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] faction of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] people.

==Description==
The Council was comprised of several [[minister]]s, including a [[Minister of Finance (New Mandalorians)/Legends|Minister of Finance]] and a [[Minister of the Interior/Legends|Minister of the Interior]], all of whom were presided over by the [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] and [[Deputy Minister/Legends|Deputy Minister]]. When the Ruling Council convened, they did so at the<ref name="Corruption" /> [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|Sundari Royal Palace]], within the New Mandalorians' [[Domed city/Legends|domed]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" />

==History==
By the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Separatists of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Ruling Council operated under the oversight of the current Prime Minister by the name of [[Almec/Legends|Almec]]. In addition, the Council and Almec were both subservient to [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]],<ref name="Corruption" /> self-styled [[Duke/Legends|duchess]] and appointed [[Anti-Mandalore|''Mand'alor'']] of the New Mandalorian people.<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the Ruling Council met at the Sundari Royal Palace to discuss the matter of Mandalore's neutrality in the [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] Wars and the resultant economical difficulties that stance had incurred for the New Mandalorians, including severe [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] shortages and [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Mandalorian black market conspiracy/Legends|dealings]] to combat said shortages. However, the proceedings quickly broke down into heated arguments and petty squabbling as the assembled ministers had no firm ideas to deal with the situation at [[Limb/Legends|hand]] and instead stooped to pointing blame upon each other and their department of governance. The meeting devolved to such a state of chaos that Duchess Kryze was forced to dismiss the Council until such a [[Time/Legends|time]] that tensions could defuse.<ref name="Corruption" /> Prime Minister Almec was later discovered to be orchestrating the black market activities on Mandalore in order to feed the impoverished New Mandalorians; he was subsequently [[Royal prison/Legends|imprisoned]] for his crimes, and the Minister of the Interior [[Armatan/Legends|Armatan]] was chosen as his replacement for the position of Prime Minister.<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" />

Nearly two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, the radical [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] faction enacted a [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|coup]] against the New Mandalorian government. Duchess Kryze was deposed and Death Watch's leader, [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], ascended to the positions of Prime Minister and ''Mand'alor'' of the New Mandalorians. The Ruling Council was fragmented, with its members either forced to swear fealty to Vizsla or put to [[Death/Legends|death]] upon their refusal. Soon after, Vizsla's leadership of both the New Mandalorians and Death Watch was usurped by the rogue [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]. Vizsla was [[Sai cha/Legends|slain]] and Almec was reinstated as Prime Minister, to serve as a puppet ruler and public face for Maul, while the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] presence remained unknown to the New Mandalorian populous. At [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Maul's direction, Almec set about selecting a new, loyal Ruling Council as he constructed his administration. When Maul was [[Battle of Mandalore/Legends|subjugated]] by his former [[Sith Master/Legends|master]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]],<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> Almec was left to rule the New Mandalorians as a pawn of Death Watch, though under his leadership, peace returned to the region.<ref name="TLJ">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The New Mandalorian Ruling Council first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the fifth episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]] [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]], entitled "[[Corruption (episode)|Corruption]]," and aired on [[October 8]], [[2010]]. The Ruling Council was later mentioned in [[Jason Fry]]'s young reader novel, ''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]'', and received a further allusion in the ''Clone Wars'' television series episode "[[Shades of Reason]]," one of several episodes the ''Shadow Conspiracy'' novel adapts to print.
